name: Mack
title: Yoga Instructor
bio: Coach Mack has a background in competitive gymnastics, beginning at a young age and later transitioning into coaching. Her experience in gymnastics sparked a continued interest in movement, leading her to become a certified yoga instructor. Mackenzie focuses on building strength, mobility, and flexibility to help athletes move better, recover, and feel their best.
